resources.string: Opens files from other apps directly, without copying them into PdfCraft’s storage. Turn off to copy them in first, as earlier versions did.
Your changes are kept in PdfCraft and will be saved to the file the next time you open it.
PdfCraft was only allowed to read %1$s, so changes can’t be saved there. Save a copy, or next time open it with Open file in PdfCraft.
Saving your changes to %1$s failed. Save a copy to keep them.
On: files other apps open for reading only are saved where they are
Off: changes to files other apps open for reading only are saved as a copy
To save straight into files other apps open for reading only, give PdfCraft All files access in Android’s settings, as other PDF readers do.
Your changes are now saved to the original file.
